honesty_note: The open-arena outcomes were already known before this mechanism was specified, so this is not a blind preregistration. It freezes the mechanism before any H2 parameter tuning or selection.

latent_state.name: directional_persistence
latent_state.initialization: P0 = 1 - exp(-L / lambda_mm), where L is recent_constrained_travel_mm
latent_state.decay: dP/dt = -P / tau_s; exact step update P(t+dt)=P(t)*exp(-dt/tau_s)

structural_predictions: For identical ants and entry conditions, larger recent_constrained_travel_mm produces larger P0.
P decays monotonically toward zero after arena entry.
At equal instantaneous random draws, larger P reduces heading diffusion but does not directly alter translational speed.
When recent_constrained_travel_mm is zero, P0 is zero and the H2 candidate reduces exactly to the baseline locomotion substrate.

evaluation_rules.purpose: mechanism implementation and reachability check only

future_unlock: Parameter fitting or model selection requires a separately recorded fitting policy. The current open-arena summary contrasts must not be used to tune lambda_mm, tau_s, or rho under v0.3.2b.
